organization: Trapped-ion group (IonQ-affiliated authors; Tham, Goldman, Debnath, Delfosse et al.)
notes: Breakeven demonstration of quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes. Implements nine quantum error-correcting codes with starkly different qubit connectivity requirements on a single trapped-ion device, achieving breakeven (logical outperforms physical) with logical error rates up to 9x better than previous demonstrations. 4 logical / 18 physical. RELEVANCE 3/5: confirms trapped-ion path to logical qubits and continues the FT trend, but small scale. Lowers the fault-tolerant cost trajectory for the 16q-transport / MERA-on-hardware path; does not change our physics anchors.
